description: Gathers up to sixteen separate cables into one polyphonic cable

inputs.text: One of the cables gathered into the output; its own channels are packed in after those of the jacks above it

outputs.text: Carries every patched input packed into one polyphonic cable, up to sixteen channels in all

notes: the inputs are packed end to end in jack order with no gaps, so unpatched jacks take up no channel; anything past the sixteenth channel is dropped
the lamps show how many channels the output is carrying
with Monophonic Inputs Only switched on, a gap in the patched jacks puts the channel count out of step with where the voltages are written, so patch from the first jack downwards
the maker's README describes a menu offering a channel count from auto to sixteen; this build's menu has the monophonic switch instead
menu: Monophonic Inputs Only — takes only the first channel of each input and places it at that input's own position, rather than packing every channel of every input together
